description: Compile a reviewed current allocation into at most 25 target pool-weight shares as one atomic batch of decodable VeToken steps. The default path only claims, splits, and votes: nothing is burned, no lock is extended, and nothing is withdrawn. The optional compact_max_lock strategy fee-safely consolidates active NFTs, extends the survivor to four years, then creates exactly one voting NFT per target; it burns every merged source NFT and lengthens the lock, and explicitly discloses both. Show the get_ve33_allocations result first and pass its exact state_id; hand the wallet the survivor, every burned source, the extension, and the decoded calls. See ekubo://docs/ve33-workflow.

chain_id.description: With ve_token, from get_ve33_allocations (STONX: 4663), not the wallet's chain

current_state_id.description: Exact state_id returned by get_ve33_allocations; preparation fails if indexed state changed (bytes32 hex)

salt_nonce.description: User-selected nonce for deterministic child VeToken IDs created by required splits (bytes32 hex)

sender.description: VeToken owner that will execute the atomic batch (address)

strategy.description: Defaults to preserve_existing_locks. compact_max_lock explicitly claims fees, consolidates active stake into one surviving NFT, extends it to four years, then creates exactly one voting NFT per target; redundant source NFT IDs are burned.

targets.description: At most 25 targets. compact_max_lock creates one final voting VeToken per target; preserve_existing_locks may require multiple NFTs per target to keep expiry-cohort decay proportional.

pool_key_id.description: Canonical Ekubo Ve33 pool key ID; the server resolves and verifies the full pool key (decimal integer)

swap_fee.description: Selected uint64 swap fee vote (decimal integer)

weight_bps.description: Target share of allocated voting power in basis points

name: prepare_ve33_reallocation
title: Prepare atomic ve(3,3) reallocation
